title: Undergraduate application routes
description: Choose the correct applicant-category route before following an application procedure.
descriptionAr: حدد مسار فئة المتقدم قبل اتباع إجراءات تقديم الطلب.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. Applicant category controls the route; submission does not guarantee admission.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: Applicant category controls the route; submission does not guarantee admission.

steps.title: UAE nationals and children of Emirati mothers
steps.instruction: UAE nationals and children of Emirati mothers: use the Ministry portal linked by your category’s admission page during announced periods.
steps.instructionAr: المواطنون وأبناء المواطنات: استخدم بوابة الوزارة التي توجه إليها صفحة قبول فئتك خلال الفترات المعلنة.

steps.title: International applicants and children of UAEU employees
steps.instruction: International applicants and children of UAEU employees: review your category’s program requirements and follow its online application link.
steps.instructionAr: الطلبة الدوليون وأبناء موظفي الجامعة: راجع شروط البرنامج لفئتك واتبع رابط التقديم الإلكتروني فيها.

steps.title: If directed to the named paid bachelor application service
steps.titleAr: إذا وُجهت إلى خدمة طلب البكالوريوس المدفوعة المحددة
steps.instruction: If directed to the named paid bachelor application service: sign up or sign in, fill and submit the application, upload its requested documents and monitor email updates. Its fee is service-specific; do not apply it to the separate Ministry route.
steps.instructionAr: إذا وُجهت إلى خدمة طلب البكالوريوس المدفوعة المحددة: أنشئ حساباً أو سجل الدخول، وأكمل الطلب وأرسله، وارفع المستندات المطلوبة وتابع البريد. الرسم خاص بهذه الخدمة ولا يُعمم على مسار الوزارة.

sources.title: UAEU Admission Application for Bachelor's Program
sources.evidenceText: Applicability: this source describes the named paid bachelor's application service, not a universal route for all undergraduate applicants. It does not establish a UAE-national/Emirati-mother application fee or replace the category-specific admission pages. Within this service, users create/sign into the linked system, submit an application, pay AED 210 including 5% VAT, upload a photo, passport and Emirates ID, and receive email updates. The published service delivery target is 12 days, not an intake deadline or guaranteed admission decision. Establish the applicant's route before applying these service-specific steps or charges.

sources.title: UAEU Undergraduate Admissions — UAE Nationals
sources.evidenceText: For UAE nationals and children of Emirati mothers, the admissions page directs applications through the Ministry portal in announced periods. General English alternatives: Grade 12 English 80%, IELTS Academic 5.0, TOEFL ITP 500 or iBT 61. Computing/AI criteria list English, mathematics and either physics or computer science at 80% or specified equivalents. These are category-specific criteria, not international-applicant rules or guaranteed admission.

sources.title: UAEU Undergraduate Admissions — International Students and Children of UAEU Employees
sources.evidenceText: For international applicants and children of UAEU employees, the page lists an accredited Grade 12 certificate and UAE Ministry of Education equivalency for high-school certificates outside the MOE curriculum, age no more than 35, no previous academic or disciplinary dismissal from any other educational institution (the restriction is not limited to UAEU), and medical fitness. General English alternatives: Grade 12 English 90%, IELTS Academic 5.5, TOEFL ITP 525 or iBT 70. Computing/AI criteria include overall average 90% and subject-specific 90% or listed equivalents. Admission is competitive; these are not UAE-national criteria. The category page links the UAEU online application route.
